notes.title: Kickstarter campaign ends!
notes.content:
From the Grimorio of Games team, thank you so much for believing in the project! Thanks to your support we made it to the top 10 Spanish videogame Kickstarter campaigns ever!

Thanks to the backers, we will have:


 Additional fully voice acted scenes!
 More music by Dale North and Emi Evans!
 2 New game modes! Boss Rush, Colosseum
 2 extra bosses and 2 extra Revenant summons (designed by the backers!)
 A customizable character that will be part of the story!


We didn't manage to reach the Challenge Dungeon goal, nor the 3D remake of the first Sword of the Necromancer game, but don't worry! 

Maybe we can't make the 50-level Challenge Dungeon, but we can slip some kind of post-game challenge anyway (one easier and cheaper to make). As for the remake, we can wait until we start selling Revenant to fund it, or maybe ask for your help in the future with a new campaign exclusively for it.

But rest assured that we will definitely make Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection!

About the Social Stretch Goals, backers and followers helped us unlock:


 A building material pack
 3 new weapon types: Katana, Naginata and Dual Knives
 A special unique shield: the Aegis
 A new optional boss: the Whispike Queen
 2 sets of costumes: Classic and Alternative


All of these unlocks will be given for free as a DLC key to all the backers of the game.

Again, thanks for your support!

notes.title: Sword of the Necromancer: Revenant Kickstarter campaign to launch in a few weeks
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We plan to launch a Kickstarter campaign for Sword of the Necromancer: Revenant, just after 2 years of the original game’s launch. The game showcased its first trailer last December, which you can see in the Steam Store page.

Link to the Kickstarter Campaign

The campaign

The first Sword of the Necromancer also had a successful crowdfunding campaign, raising €201,256 from its initial €15,000 goal. Revenant‘s campaign will have an initial goal to fund the game’s physical edition for consoles, but will include additional stretch goals to add more features to the game in all platforms. Sword of the Necromancer: Revenant has been announced for PC, Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox One and Xbox Series.

Backers will be able to obtain the game at a lower price than when it comes out. Exclusive campaign rewards will also be available, including a special surprise. The campaign will also offer limited “Early Bird” pledge tiers, so signing up to receive the notification when the campaign launches is recommended! (It also helps us with visibility on Kickstarter!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305322/8c90b46f779056606bbbf3ac475709de751529a0.png

In the meantime, players can go to the game’s Steam Store page and wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2200940/

Thank you for your support!
